alate: Head deep brown, labrum yellowish brown, antennae pale brown, pronotum deep brown. Head elongate-oval, the sides parallel, the posterior margin rounded out, the top of the head slightly arched. The distance from the lower margin of the compound eye to the lower margin of the head about half the long diameter of the compound eye. Ocelli elongate-round, touching the compound eye. Antennae with 16 segments. The middle of both the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum shallowly concave, the sides nearly parallel. The forewing scale completely covers the hindwing scale.
soldier: Head blackish brown in front, paler behind the frontal ridges, becoming yellowish brown at the posterior margin; labrum and antennae yellowish brown; pronotum yellowish brown with the anterior margin brown. Head nearly square, the lateral margins slightly bulging near the posterior end, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The margins of the frontal ridges and the frontal surface slightly rough, smooth behind the ridges; the middle of the top of the head flat or shallowly concave; the frontal ridges distinctly raised, forming a broad U in dorsal view, its midpoint flat or slightly concave, the angle between the frontal slope and the mandibles about one hundred and twenty degrees in profile. Antennae with 11–13 segments, inserted between the two tubercles, the frontal tubercles short and thick, the genal tubercles slender and long. Labrum mitre-shaped, with two hairs at its tip. Eyes distinct, slightly projecting. Mandibles short and flat, the basal prominence raised, the left mandible with three marginal teeth, the right with two. The pronotum about as wide as the head, its anterior margin V-shaped, the anterolateral angles notched, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin rather straight.
